title: World Config
description: Global generation parameters shared between svarog-engine and the client.

tile_size_m.description: Target tile edge length in metres. Engine picks the closest XYZ zoom level for the generated area. Examples: 200 → ~zoom 18 (Prague), 720 → ~zoom 15, 90 → ~zoom 19.

draco.description: Produce Draco-compressed GLB (KHR_draco_mesh_compression). Client must have DRACOLoader configured.

upsample_factor.description: Bilinear upsample factor applied to 30 m SRTM DEM. upsample=10 → ~3 m/cell, upsample=20 → ~1.5 m/cell.

load_radius_tiles.description: Radius of tiles loaded around the player (tile count). 1 = 3×3 grid, 2 = 5×5 grid.
